questions.question: What is an AWS Region?
options: A geographic location with multiple Availability Zones
questions.correct_answer: A geographic location with multiple Availability Zones
questions.explanation: An AWS Region is a physical location in the world containing multiple isolated data centers called Availability Zones.

questions.question: What is an IAM user?
options: An identity with specific permissions to access AWS services
questions.correct_answer: An identity with specific permissions to access AWS services
questions.explanation: IAM (Identity and Access Management) users have credentials and policies defining exactly what AWS resources and actions they can access.

questions.question: What is an AMI in EC2?
options: Amazon Machine Image — the OS and software template for EC2 instances
questions.correct_answer: Amazon Machine Image — the OS and software template for EC2 instances
questions.explanation: AMIs define what OS and pre-installed software an EC2 instance launches with. You can use AWS-provided AMIs or create custom ones.

questions.question: What is an EC2 Security Group?
options: A virtual firewall controlling inbound/outbound traffic to EC2 instances
questions.correct_answer: A virtual firewall controlling inbound/outbound traffic to EC2 instances
questions.explanation: Security Groups are stateful firewalls. You create rules specifying which ports and IP ranges can connect to your EC2 instance.

questions.question: What is an S3 Bucket?
options: A container for storing objects (files) in S3
questions.correct_answer: A container for storing objects (files) in S3
questions.explanation: An S3 bucket is a logical container for objects. Bucket names must be globally unique across all AWS accounts.

questions.question: What does 'aws s3 sync ./dist s3://my-bucket/' do?
options: Uploads only changed files from dist/ to the bucket
Deletes all files in the bucket
questions.correct_answer: Uploads only changed files from dist/ to the bucket
questions.explanation: sync compares local and S3 files and uploads only new or modified files — ideal for efficient static website deployments.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of RDS over a self-managed database on EC2?
options: AWS handles backups, patching, scaling, and failover automatically
questions.correct_answer: AWS handles backups, patching, scaling, and failover automatically
questions.explanation: RDS is a managed service — AWS handles operational database tasks so you focus on your application instead of DBA work.

questions.question: What does RDS Multi-AZ provide?
options: Automatic failover to a standby in another Availability Zone
questions.correct_answer: Automatic failover to a standby in another Availability Zone
questions.explanation: Multi-AZ maintains a synchronous standby. If the primary fails, AWS automatically promotes the standby with minimal downtime.

questions.question: What does 'serverless' mean in the context of AWS Lambda?
options: The function runs without a network
You don't provision servers — AWS manages infrastructure automatically
questions.correct_answer: You don't provision servers — AWS manages infrastructure automatically
questions.explanation: Serverless means AWS automatically provisions, scales, and manages the underlying infrastructure. You only write and deploy your function code.

questions.question: What is the maximum execution timeout for an AWS Lambda function?
questions.explanation: Lambda functions have a maximum execution timeout of 15 minutes. For longer tasks, use EC2, ECS, or Step Functions.

questions.question: What is AWS CloudFront?
options: A CDN that caches and distributes content globally from edge locations
questions.correct_answer: A CDN that caches and distributes content globally from edge locations
questions.explanation: CloudFront is AWS's Content Delivery Network. It caches your content at locations worldwide, reducing latency for global users.

questions.question: What does S3 static website hosting allow you to do?
options: Serve HTML, CSS, and JS files directly from S3 as a website
questions.correct_answer: Serve HTML, CSS, and JS files directly from S3 as a website
questions.explanation: S3 static hosting serves your React/HTML build files as a website accessible via a public URL without any server.

questions.question: What is AWS Auto Scaling?
options: Automatically adds or removes EC2 instances based on traffic load
questions.correct_answer: Automatically adds or removes EC2 instances based on traffic load
questions.explanation: Auto Scaling adds EC2 instances when traffic spikes and removes them when traffic drops, maintaining performance while minimizing cost.

questions.question: What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?
options: A managed platform that deploys and manages apps without manual EC2 configuration
questions.correct_answer: A managed platform that deploys and manages apps without manual EC2 configuration
questions.explanation: Elastic Beanstalk provisions EC2, load balancers, and auto scaling automatically. You just upload your code and it handles the infrastructure.

questions.question: Why should you set up AWS billing alerts?
options: To receive notifications when AWS charges exceed your threshold and avoid surprise bills
questions.correct_answer: To receive notifications when AWS charges exceed your threshold and avoid surprise bills
questions.explanation: Billing alerts notify you via email when estimated charges exceed a set amount, preventing unexpected large charges on your account.
